messages:
leo_finance: incoming EUR transfer posted to our clearing account this morning but the remittance is obscured — our system allocated it to 'Unknown'. amount €42,500.00, value date 2026-03-16. ref on file: 'ACME LTD INV#45678 / ORDER: 9...'. anyone seen this?
maria_ops: I can see the ACH feed. Our importer truncated the freeform note at 32 chars, so it shows 'ACME LTD INV#45678 / OR'. that explains the mismatch to PO lookup.
leo_finance: here's the raw rails memo we received:```ACME LTD / ACME BANK PLT / INV#45678 / ORDER: 98765 / ORG-REF: XK-99881``` but the correspondent stripped after the slash in our feed.
ashley_recon: we need a full MT103 or a bank statement screenshot from the sender to prove remit. without the full reference we can't confidently post to invoice. can sales ask the payer for MT103 trace? :eyes:
teo_sales: pinging customer now. @ashley_recon, confirm the exact payment details i should request — amount €42,500.00, value date 2026-03-16, sender bank shows 'ACME BANK PLT', our internal trace id TRX-20260316-987654. ask for MT103 with fields 20, 32A, 50a, 59, 70 please.
payments-bot: Alert — Unmatched incoming EUR 42,500 detected. Holding funds in unapplied account. Ticket created: PAY-1893.
ashley_recon: also note: correspondent sometimes moves invoice into the 70 field which gets dropped by some gateways. ask them to include full 70/ remittance line and a copy of the sending bank's MT103 (PDF) or bank statement line with the swift trace.
maria_ops: fallback if MT103 isn't available: manual allocation. @teo_sales can you confirm if invoice 23456/PO-98765 exists and is open for this amount? if yes we can do a one-off apply and attach evidence when received.
teo_sales: confirmed — invoice 23456 open for €42,500, PO-98765 attached. i've asked the customer for MT103 screenshot and statement excerpt, expect reply in ~2 hours. i'll update PAY-1893 when they send it.
leo_finance: thanks all — accounting holding allocation until docs arrive. leaving note on the ticket: hold -> need MT103 or bank stmt. :thumbsup:
